lines.text: Archaeologists found pots of it in ancient Egyptian tombs.  Still edible.
Here's why. Honey is only about 17% water. Germs that land in it get the water sucked right out of them.
It's also acidic.  Roughly as sour as orange juice.
And bees add an enzyme that slowly makes hydrogen peroxide.  A built-in germ killer.
So if your honey turns hard and cloudy? It hasn't gone bad. It's just crystallised. Warm the jar in hot water.
Send this to the friend who threw theirs away. Because remember…
